entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-15
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Aspire run-session server: SendMessageAsync over-releases _webSocketAccess on cancellation, permitting concurrent WebSocket sends #55546
  • AspireService: SocketConnectionManager can deadlock (_socketConnectionsLock vs CancellationTokenRegistration.Dispose), wedging the whole brokered dispatch #55560
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.New.IntegrationTests.CommonTemplatesTests.FeaturesSupport: intermittent hang (test host hang-dump timeout, exit code 7) #55551

Updated

  • [macOS arm64] dotnet-watch cleanup hangs in Process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true) #55636
  • FileWatcherTests.NewFile(False) flaky failure — Add and Update events reported out of order #55588
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.FileWatcherTests.MoveFile: flaky failure — rename source event delivered as Update instead of Delete #55518
  • Test flakiness for Microsoft.NET.Sdk.StaticWebAssets.Tests.StaticWebAssetsIntegrationTest.Build_DoesNotUpdateManifest_WhenHasNotChanged #55516
  • Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.IntegrationTests RegistryTests.CanReadManifestFromRegistry: flaky failure - CONTAINER1014 Manifest pull failed (external registry BadRequest) #55495
  • [Known Build Error] DotnetNewTestTemplatesTests.MSTestAndPlaywrightProjectTemplate_...CanBeInstalledAndTestsArePassing fails with UnauthorizedAccessException: Access to the path 'testhost.exe' is denied #55174
  • SourceFileUpdateTests.RenameSourceFile: flaky failure — FileNotFoundException on Foo.cs / missing '> Renamed.cs' output #55137
  • MSBuild child node exits prematurely with ObjectDisposedException in BinaryLogger #55076
  • Flaky: Collection is not empty #54887
  • NavMenu.razor(1,5): error RZ10007: The attribute 'class' is used two or more times for this element. Attributes must be unique (case-insensitive) #54826
  • Test flakiness witt Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantBuildsToBeIncremental tests #54823
  • Template Engine SSL Connection Issue #51574
  • Workload Feature Band Test Sometimes Fails #45314
  • Failure on Helix tests - Tests timing out #40074
  • dotnet-watch tests failing #40006
  • Support F# Hot Reload in CLI dotnet watch through a typed provider #55464
  • dotnet watch: Mac Catalyst hot-reload agent WebSocket drops before the first edit; updates fail but watch reports "changes applied" #55488
  • *.slnx files not supporting File wildcards #53534
  • Warn when TargetFrameworks declares a single framework: it evaluates every such project twice #55699
  • dotnetup: PowerShell profile may sync across machines #55591
  • Thread the project's C# LangVersion through the source-generator-hosted rzc discover path #55508

PullRequests

Created

  • Warn when TargetFrameworks declares a single framework #55795
  • Guard synced PowerShell profiles against missing dotnetup #55794
  • Thread C# LangVersion through Razor source-generator discovery #55793

Updated

  • [wasm] Support browser-wasm/wasi-wasm ReadyToRun in ResolveReadyToRunCompilers #55785
    arch-wasm
  • Only download runtimes for referenced frameworks #53518
    Servicing-consider, breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55735
